orchestration.note: Controls which NB_CopyEventDetection_* notebooks do work when invoked by the orchestrating Data Pipeline (PL_ShortcutMonitoringOrchestrator). The pipeline's own schedule trigger is the single source of truth for run cadence - this flag is purely an enable/disable switch per engine, not a cadence control.

auth.note: clientSecret is entered manually in the live config.json at Files/config/config.json in LH_ShortcutMonitoring. Key Vault-backed secret storage was considered and deliberately deferred - see docs/Shortcut Monitoring Solution - Design Document.md.
